scope: Seven French Google Play description samples: six international apps also used for English/German, plus 1bsyl. Descriptive sample, not verified popularity, search-volume or ranking data.
method: NFC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, curly apostrophes normalized to straight apostrophes and dash variants to hyphen. Exact contiguous phrases delimited by Unicode letters/digits. Accents retained; singular/plural, inflections, spacing and synonyms remain separate. Body between À propos de ce jeu and Date de mise à jour, including public short description; excludes title, tags, reviews, screenshots and linked websites. Nested rows can overlap. Pages may be cached or region-dependent. Full competitor prose is not persisted.

terminologySources.use: French publisher terminology for rows, columns, 3×3 blocks and notes; not counted among seven app descriptions.
